subject: Fathom Health onboarding — security prerequisites & PO setup
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@fathomhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fathom Health onboarding — security prerequisites & PO setup

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for agreeing to move Redwood onto Fathom's vendor roster. Before we can finalize the SOW and issue a PO, procurement has asked for a short package of compliance artifacts and a few logistics details so we can get finance to fast-track payment. Could you please provide the following items by EOD Tuesday (16 Feb) if possible?

- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted OK)
- ISO 27001 certificate or summary of scope
- Recent penetration test or a formal letter from your security provider summarizing results and critical findings
- Vendor billing contact + invoicing email and remit-to address
- W9 (for US entities) or applicable tax form
- High-level SOW (1–2 pages) or a statement of work template so legal can align on contract terms

If you have a standard procurement packet, feel free to drop a Drive link. We can also accept DocuSign for the initial PO terms once the billing info is confirmed — I can circulate that from our side.

Cc'ing Marissa (Sales Ops) and Karthik (Security/Compliance) to keep procurement and scope alignment in the loop. Happy to stand up a 20-min sync tomorrow if that helps.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0187

[Attachment: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@fathomhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@fathomhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fathom Health onboarding — security prerequisites & PO setup

Hi Sean —

Thanks for the list — attaching the SOC 2 Type II (redacted) and our ISO certificate. The full pen test report is scoped to our security vendor, but I've included a signed letter summarizing the assessment and remediation status. W9 is attached as well.

A few notes:
- SOC 2 covers our ingestion and inference endpoints; the report date is Oct 2026.
- ISO 27001 scope excludes occasional third-party integrations (listed in the cert).
- Pen test letter confirms no critical findings; two medium findings were remediated in Dec 2026.

For invoicing: billing@fathomhealth.com — remit to Fathom Health, 1224 Willow Ave, San Mateo, CA 94401.

I'll also drop a link to our standard vendor packet in Drive; if you need the pen test vendor to sign an NDA to release full details we can coordinate that now.

Attaching: Fathom_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf; Fathom_ISO27001_Cert_2025.pdf; PenTest_Letter_Summary.txt; Fathom_W9.pdf

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Alyssa.Chen@fathomhealth.com
Procurement — Fathom Health

[Attachments: Fathom_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (pdf), Fathom_ISO27001_Cert_2025.pdf (pdf), PenTest_Letter_Summary.txt (text), Fathom_W9.pdf (pdf)]

Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fathom Health onboarding — security prerequisites & PO setup

Great — appreciate the quick turnaround, Alyssa.

Two small asks from Sales Ops & Finance:
1) Could you confirm the legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the PO (for example, including any LLC/Inc suffix)? We need that to match your W9.
2) Can you provide the name and email for the person who will approve the invoice (approver on file)? Finance prefers an approver contact rather than a generic mailbox if possible.

Also attaching a short 1-page SOW template that we typically use for initial engagements. If Fathom can sign that or provide a counter-SOW, legal will plug it into the contract.

If you prefer, we can issue a preliminary PO with estimated monthly spend to get things moving and update the SOW post-signature.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Thanks team — I've reviewed the SOC 2 and the pen test letter. Nothing high-risk flagged for Redwood's integration surface. Two quick notes for our records:
- Please confirm the exact endpoint(s) we'll be using (production inference URL) and expected token retention policy so we can update our access control docs.
- Once we have the DocuSign PO signed and the W9 matches the legal entity, I'll mark security clearance complete and send a short onboarding checklist for the infra team to finish the network allowlist.

If Alyssa can route the DocuSign to billing@fathomhealth.com and Samantha Ortiz as approver, Finance can get the PO out the same day.

Karthik
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
